notes: The game is a scored soccer match in a modern World Cup ground, so Sports leads and the pitch is space-bounded — touchlines, goal mouths, a centre restart and full markings, dressed as a Full Stadium since the prompt insists it be a real stadium and not a baseplate. Party & Casual is named second because the voting lobby and round structure are genuinely its territory, and it supplies the lobby as social-hub plus the vote display, which I promoted to the leaderboard wall since a prominent lobby screen is what that option builds. I rejected space-staged even though a lobby-and-match layout normally suggests it: the answers say the lobby is attached to the stadium as one map, so separating them would cost P4 for something the user ruled out, and the bleachers are the only reason this is tiered at all. Without a user I assumed the lobby sits at the stadium concourse with players walking out to the pitch rather than teleporting, one pitch shared by whichever two countries win the vote, and no enterable concourse interiors, keeping this off P3.
